content:
Iris: Quick design sync: invite modal adjustments for RBAC + audit jump. Goals: role suggestions, clearer copy for persistence, move SSO into a compact chip, add tiny audit-link.

Noah: Small mock?

Iris: ```Invite to Org
[email] [Role v] [Suggest: Viewer, Analyst] [Keep access until revoked (i)] [SSO •] [Send]```

Priya: Copy: use 'Keep access until revoked' and helper 'Remains assigned until an admin removes it.' One-liner only.

Marco: A11y: helper must be keyboard focusable with aria-describedby; suggested roles announced via live region; SSO chip needs clear state announcements.

Noah: SSO chip states: enforced (red, disables persistent), optional (neutral), unset (link to setup). Tooltip on hover.

Iris: Audit link under summary: 'View invite audit' -> /audit?user=joe%40x.com&action=invite. Make screen-reader label full context.

A11yBot: Keyboard flow spec: email -> role dropdown -> select -> helper -> toggle persistent -> SSO chip -> send. Ensure visible focus rings.

Priya: Analytics: invite.role_selected, invite.persistent, invite.sso_opened, invite.audit_clicked.

Iris: I'll add two Figma variants (chip vs inline) and a short aria/keyboard spec. Review by EOD tomorrow.
